market_definition: The Global Ethanolamine Market covers ethanolamines: BY PRODUCT TYPE: Monoethanolamine (MEA), Diethanolamine (DEA), Triethanolamine (TEA), Methyldiethanolamine (MDEA). BY GRADE: Industrial, Pharmaceutical, Cosmetic, Electronic. BY FUNCTION: Chemical Intermediate, pH Control Agent, Gas Treatment Agent, Surfactant Intermediate, Corrosion Inhibitor, Emulsifying Agent, Others. BY APPLICATION: Gas Sweetening, Surfactants & Detergents, Personal Care & Cosmetics, Herbicides & Agrochemicals, Cement Grinding Aids, Metalworking Fluids, Textile Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Water Treatment, Chemical Processing, Others. BY END-USER INDUSTRY: Oil & Gas, Home & Personal Care, Agriculture, Construction, Chemical Manufacturing, Pharmaceuticals, Textile, Water & Wastewater Treatment, Others. BY DISTRIBUTION CHANNEL: Direct Sales, Indirect Sales. BY REGION: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, Middle East, Africa. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR (indirect sales channel): a chemical distributor, trader, importer or stockist that buys ethanolamines from their producers and resells them to industrial users. EXCLUDED companies: ethanolamine producers and their own sales subsidiaries, and companies not selling ethanolamines.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
